name: Wizardry III: Diamond no Kishi
summary: Wizardry III: Diamond no Kishi is a port of Wizardry: Knight of Diamonds - The Second Scenario for the Famicom. The Japanese ports of Wizardry II & III reverse the order of the games. The Japanese Wizardry II is a port of Wizardry III, and the Japanese Wizardry III is a port of Wizardry II.
